meta.title: NestSelf – a modern employee wellbeing benefit
meta.description: A modern employee wellbeing benefit. Psychological, legal and financial support for employees and their families, through one confidential platform.

hero.title: Support for work. And everything around it.
hero.lead: Give your employees and their families access to licensed psychologists, legal professionals and financial consultants – all through one confidential platform.

photos.alt: A warm kitchen scene representing everyday life
A person walking outdoors, taking a break
A family preparing a meal together

services.title: Three areas of support, one platform
services.lead: Licensed psychologists, legal professionals and certified financial consultants, available online and in person.

items.title: Therapy & Counselling
items.body: Licensed psychologists and qualified psychotherapists for individual, couples and family sessions – online or in person.

items.title: Legal Consultation
items.body: Confidential guidance on personal legal matters – family law, tenancy, consumer rights.

items.title: Financial Guidance
items.body: Budgeting, debt management, savings planning and retirement guidance from certified financial professionals.

steps.title: How it works for employees
steps.lead: Four steps from your first sign-in to a conversation with a professional.

photo.alt: Colleagues taking a short break outside the office

steps.title: Activate with your work email
steps.body: Your employer has already set up NestSelf for you. Sign in with your work email to see what is available.

steps.title: Choose an area and a time
steps.body: Pick therapy, legal or financial support. Browse available professionals and find a time that suits you.

steps.title: Talk, in your language
steps.body: Have your session in Serbian, Hungarian or English – online or in person. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed.

steps.title: Keep going with follow-ups and the library
steps.body: Book follow-up sessions, explore self-help tools, read articles and join webinars at your own pace.

employers.title: A wellbeing benefit your team will actually use
paragraphs: NestSelf brings psychological, legal and financial support into one platform that employees understand and trust. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed. HR sees anonymised usage for groups of 10 or more.

life.title: Support for the people around you
paragraphs: Relationships, parenting, caring for a parent, or navigating a legal question that has nothing to do with work. Where your employer's plan includes family members, they get the same access to therapy, legal and financial support.

items.question: Who can use NestSelf?
items.answer: Any employee whose employer has activated the NestSelf programme. Where your employer's plan includes family members, partners and children can also access the service.

items.question: Is it confidential?
items.answer: Yes. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed. HR receives only anonymised, aggregated reports when the group is large enough to prevent identification – a minimum of 10 people.

items.question: What does it cost employees?
items.answer: NestSelf is a benefit funded by the employer. Employees pay nothing for the services their plan covers.

items.question: How fast can we launch?
items.answer: Most organisations go from signed agreement to employee access in two to four weeks. We provide a communications toolkit to help you announce the programme.

items.question: Which languages are supported?
items.answer: Sessions are available in Serbian, Hungarian and English. The platform interface and all content are available in all three languages.

items.question: What if someone is in crisis?
items.answer: If you or someone you know is in immediate danger, call the emergency number now. Serbia: 112 (emergency), 194 (ambulance); Centar Srce 0800 300 303. Hungary: 112 (emergency), 104 (ambulance); Lelki Elsősegély Telefonszolgálat 116 123. NestSelf also provides guidance on accessing urgent professional support.
